propositions: signing.py at 800 LOC is at hard cap with zero headroom, blocking any new edits and causing CI failures on minimal changes

splitting signing.py into three acyclic modules (_signing_manifest.py, _signing_hmac.py, and signing.py) along natural call-graph seams brings each file into 200-500 LOC target band with sustainable margin
monkeypatch targets in test_attestation_signing.py must be re-anchored from signing module to _signing_manifest module to preserve patch semantics after the split
re-export surface of 34 signing module attributes and 9 callables must be preserved unchanged in parameter lists to maintain public API and pass test_reuse_surface_doc.py introspection
guard tests must verify that patches on moved symbols are observed by their consumers to close vacuous-pass risks and enforce that patches target the defining module
